content.short: Stampd.io is a blockchain-based verification tool for timestamping and securing documents on Cardano.
content.description: Stampd.io is a specialized digital utility that enables users to timestamp and verify documents on the Cardano blockchain. The platform creates an immutable, permanent record of a file's existence and integrity at a specific point in time, providing proof of origin without exposing the document's content. This technology is ideal for intellectual property protection, legal compliance, and authenticating academic certifications as NFTs. By bridging the gap between traditional data and decentralized security, Stampd.io ensures that critical digital assets remain verifiable and tamper-proof.
